summary: The candidate skill 'Legacy Module State Synchronization' and peer skill 'Legacy Session Compatibility Bridge' (a4c43354-1375-5e17-95ae-4b8c2b113dff) both address the same semantic capability: synchronizing session and trace context state to legacy module references for backward compatibility. The candidate focuses on importing and assigning to agentops.legacy module globals, while the peer focuses on assigning to module-level globals (_client_init_trace_context, _client_legacy_session_for_init_trace). These are complementary steps in the same workflow. The peer skill is more complete (includes verification and logging), so the candidate should merge into it. Both are micro_skills at the same asset_level in the initialization stage with overlapping task_family (state_management/compatibility_maintenance) and method_family (module_global_sync/state_synchronization).
